source_title: Woman dies after changing medication on ChatGPT advice; Google CEO had warned of risk
source_excerpt: A lawsuit against OpenAI has highlighted the risks of relying on artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots for health advice. Qun Wan and Meiqin Xu filed a lawsuit October 27, 2026, over the death of their 31-year-old daughter, Bowen Wan. A software engineer in Seattle, Wan has been on prescription medications for years to manage her epilepsy. Her parents allege that ChatGPT encouraged her to gradually reduce her daily anti-seizure medication to zero without medical supervision, leading to her sudden death.
